Your @username belongs to your messaging server. Share your full address so people on other servers can find you. This is not a wallet address.
Name, bio and photo personalize your profile on this device. They are not published to the server or shared with contacts.

Verification takes place on Base mainnet. P2P.me links one person to one wallet across its apps. Use the wallet you intend to keep; an identity already linked to another wallet cannot be linked again.
The hosted wizard captures your passport and face. Midori receives only the on-chain attestation. Decisions are automatic; there is no manual review.
I understand that verification links my identity to this wallet.
Submit the attestation to the ReputationManager on Base from this wallet. This transaction pays ETH gas and does not buy USDC.
Passport verification is available for supported trading countries.
Complete the hosted verification, then return here to refresh its result.
Attestation saved. Review the network fee before submitting it.
The session or attestation expired. No new transaction will be sent automatically.
P2P.me rejected this verification automatically. The account limit has not been enabled.
This identity is already linked to another account. P2P.me does not allow linking it to another wallet.
Verification was cancelled. No verification transaction has been sent.
The verification result could not be recovered. Contact P2P.me with this wallet address before starting again; Midori will not repeat the code exchange.
Verification transaction pending. Refresh to check its canonical receipt.
Passport verification confirmed on Base. Return to P2P to refresh your actual transaction limit.
The verification transaction reverted. The account was not verified by this transaction.
Passport verification is currently unavailable for this account or country. Try refreshing later.
Could not open the passport wizard. Use Continue verification to try opening it again.
This wallet already has passport verification on Base. Refresh its actual transaction limit; another passport session is unnecessary.
